author: ThatWeird1
body:
ThatWeird1
banned for hacking
I do not have any evidence that i was not hacking other than my lack of knowledge on hacking and how to hack.  I simply trying to enjoy some time with my friend playing our fav server.  neither of us had any reason to hack.  i think the ban should be lifted because i was neither hacking nor do i have any future plans to hack.  the only reason i play on avicus is to have fun. i do not need to hack to have fun.  i do not know how else i can attempt to convince any of the moderators to unban me, other than to say i have no need, nor knowledge.  also id like to appologize for appealing so soon, I just want to get back to playing on Avic. If you need a little bit of evidence I suggest looking at my KD ratio, its pretty bad...
